notes: Taiwan: accounts on the Taiwan server get their own game version. Apex sets the engine's Taiwan version separately, takes it from the server, proves it with a Taiwan account's own login and tries one step up when it is refused, and a refused Taiwan account no longer counts against the normal version. The portal IGG login import can ask for the Taiwan server. Rental stop only acts on accounts that are really running and knows whose rental ended. The delete confirmation, the engine notice, the template and form editors and the device import no longer run off the screen when the list is long.
